mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_destinations ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, display_name, endpoint_url, traces_enabled, traces_endpoint_url, traces_content_mode, traces_max_content_bytes, workspace_scope, header_names, headers_ciphertext, headers_nonce, headers_wrapped_dek, headers_format_version, headers_key_provider, headers_key_version, state, disabled_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.DisplayName}, #{params.EndpointURL}, #{params.TracesEnabled}, #{params.TracesEndpointURL}, #{params.TracesContentMode}, #{params.TracesMaxContentBytes}, #{params.WorkspaceScope}, CAST(#{params.HeaderNames} AS jsonb), #{params.HeadersCiphertext,sensitive=true}, #{params.HeadersNonce,sensitive=true}, #{params.HeadersWrappedDEK,sensitive=true}, #{params.HeadersFormatVersion}, #{params.HeadersKeyProvider}, #{params.HeadersKeyVersion}, #{params.State}, #{params.DisabledReason}, #{params.Now}, #{params.Now} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_destinations SET display_name = #{params.DisplayName}, endpoint_url = #{params.EndpointURL}, traces_enabled = #{params.TracesEnabled}, traces_endpoint_url = #{params.TracesEndpointURL}, traces_content_mode = #{params.TracesContentMode}, traces_max_content_bytes = #{params.TracesMaxContentBytes}, workspace_scope = #{params.WorkspaceScope}, header_names = CAST(#{params.HeaderNames} AS jsonb), headers_ciphertext = #{params.HeadersCiphertext,sensitive=true}, headers_nonce = #{params.HeadersNonce,sensitive=true}, headers_wrapped_dek = #{params.HeadersWrappedDEK,sensitive=true}, headers_format_version = #{params.HeadersFormatVersion}, headers_key_provider = #{params.HeadersKeyProvider}, headers_key_version = #{params.HeadersKeyVersion}, failure_started_at = CASE WHEN state = 'disabled' AND #{params.State} = 'enabled' THEN NULL ELSE failure_started_at END, state = #{params.State}, disabled_reason = #{params.DisabledReason}, updated_at = #{params.Now} WHERE organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND updated_at = #{params.ExpectedUpdatedAt} RETURNING

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM telemetry_destination_workspaces WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND destination_uuid = #{destinationUUID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_destination_workspaces (destination_uuid, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid) VALUES (#{destinationUUID}, #{organizationUUID}, #{workspaceUUID}) ON CONFLICT (destination_uuid, workspace_uuid) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_destinations SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, headers_ciphertext = NULL, headers_nonce = NULL, headers_wrapped_dek = NULL, headers_format_version = NULL, headers_key_provider = NULL, headers_key_version = NULL WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM telemetry_destinations d WHERE d.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.state = 'enabled' AND d.traces_enabled AND (d.workspace_scope = 'all' OR (d.workspace_scope = 'include' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM telemetry_destination_workspaces w WHERE w.destination_uuid = d.uuid AND w.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND w.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID})) OR (d.workspace_scope = 'exclude' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM telemetry_destination_workspaces w WHERE w.destination_uuid = d.uuid AND w.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND w.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID}))) ORDER BY d.created_at ASC, d.uuid ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_destinations SET last_success_at = #{now}, failure_started_at = NULL WHERE uuid = #{destinationUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WITH target AS ( SELECT uuid, COALESCE(failure_started_at, #{params.Now}) AS started_at FROM telemetry_destinations WHERE uuid = #{params.DestinationUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND state = 'enabled' FOR UPDATE ), decision AS ( SELECT uuid, started_at, CASE WHEN #{params.ImmediateReason} != '' THEN #{params.ImmediateReason} WHEN #{params.Now} >= started_at + make_interval(secs => #{params.DisableAfterSeconds}) THEN 'sustained_failure' ELSE '' END AS reason FROM target ), updated AS ( UPDATE telemetry_destinations d SET last_error = #{params.Error}, last_error_at = #{params.Now}, failure_started_at = decision.started_at, state = CASE WHEN decision.reason != '' THEN 'disabled' ELSE d.state END, disabled_reason = CASE WHEN decision.reason != '' THEN decision.reason ELSE d.disabled_reason END, updated_at = CASE WHEN decision.reason != '' THEN #{params.Now} ELSE d.updated_at END FROM decision WHERE d.uuid = decision.uuid RETURNING d.state ) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT state = 'disabled' FROM updated), false)
